name: Joe Slowik
biography: Joe Slowik has over 15 years' experience across multiple cyber domains. Currently, Joe leads threat intelligence, hunting, detection engineering, and purple teaming functions for Huntress. Previously, Joe performed in-depth threat intelligence research for DomainTools and Dragos, and led incident response operations at Los Alamos National Laboratory. Joe started off in information security through various roles in the US Navy and intelligence community.
